scope: read-only diagnosis of Z1 3-seed x 200-update development results; no final holdout opened

confirmed_results.failure_bottleneck: final lateral error above 50 um; depth and orientation generally satisfied

hypotheses_ranked.name: zero-initialized actor interacts with per-mini-batch adaptive KL schedule
hypotheses_ranked.confidence: learning-rate increase is observed and intentional library behavior; causal performance impact is unknown until fixed-LR comparison

rsl_rl_v3_0_1_source.behavior: when KL is below desired_kl/2, learning rate is multiplied by 1.5 for each mini-batch, capped at 1e-2

hypotheses_ranked.minimal_test: keep Z1 unchanged except schedule=fixed and learning_rate=3e-4; compare the same frozen development conditions

hypotheses_ranked.name: stochastic exploration remains larger than the lateral success window
hypotheses_ranked.confidence: exploration scale exceeds the strict lateral tolerance; impairment of training precision remains a hypothesis

evidence.pilot_directional_evidence: std 0.6 A0 scored 0/32, std 0.1 E1 scored 7/32, and std 0.1 plus zero-init Z1 scored 10/32

hypotheses_ranked.minimal_test: after fixed-LR result, keep fixed LR and reduce initial std to 0.02-0.03; retain entropy initially to isolate std

hypotheses_ranked.name: legacy lateral shaping is ten times coarser than the success threshold and terminal credit is long-horizon sparse
hypotheses_ranked.confidence: medium; report telemetry shows weak separation but prior discounted-shaping runs are exploration-confounded

evidence.action_cost_report_mean: absolute value below 1e-4 in all nine reports

hypotheses_ranked.minimal_test: after fixed-LR and lower-std tests, change only lateral scale toward 50 um or use a smooth threshold-margin term

hypotheses_ranked.name: standard 79D policy failed to learn a lateral bias-cancelling map
hypotheses_ranked.confidence: high for the observed behavior; unknown whether the cause is weak cue or optimization
hypotheses_ranked.minimal_diagnosis: record valid 79D rollout observations and fit held-out linear/MLP probes from observation to the sampled bias 6D; separately run same zero-init, low-noise, fixed-LR setup with the existing 85D privileged diagnostic

ruled_down_or_not_supported.claim: inactive setup steps dominate PPO samples
ruled_down_or_not_supported.evidence: mean inactive steps per episode were 4.19-4.41 at 30 Hz versus roughly 600 active steps

ruled_down_or_not_supported.claim: action clipping or residual bounds are the main limitation
ruled_down_or_not_supported.finding: not established for stochastic training; only deterministic evaluation saturation was measured
ruled_down_or_not_supported.evidence: all nine deterministic evaluation reports recorded zero saturation; this does not establish whether PPO training actions were clipped

ruled_down_or_not_supported.claim: empirical observation normalization being false is itself the root cause
ruled_down_or_not_supported.evidence: the 79D builder already scales position, rotation, joint, force, command, and tracking-error fields explicitly
fixed held start and scripted ALIGN can encode bias-correlated cues in joint pose and tracking error; existing 85D 20-update result used std 0.6 and no Z1 zero-init comparison

observation_contract.standard_observation_bias: episode-fixed biased frozen estimator; no explicit bias latent
observation_contract.privileged_85d_mode: appends normalized sampled translation and rotation bias 6D

provenance_discrepancy.finding: reports record base observation noise values of 1.5 mm and 1 degree, but the RJ45 training wrapper bypasses base noisy observation construction
provenance_discrepancy.actual_policy_input: wrapper uses the frozen biased estimator without per-step Gaussian position/rotation noise
provenance_discrepancy.impact: do not attribute Z1 failure to the reported 1.5 mm / 1 degree values; document them as inherited base config not applied to wrapper policy input

recommended_sequential_ablation: same fixed LR with init noise std 0.02 only
same fixed LR and std 0.02 with lateral reward scale 50 um only
then 79D bias-predictability probe and matched 85D privileged diagnostic before adding data or multiple grasps
after a learning signal is demonstrated on the frozen held state, add multiple held grasps and separate train/development/generalization splits
plan_risk: Changing lateral_scale to exactly 50 um may create a steep or noisy gradient at the strict threshold; predeclare 50-100 um or use a smooth margin term and change only one reward dimension. Do not change LR, noise, and reward in one run if causal attribution is required.
